name: New Frontiers

categories.label: VP chips
categories.hint: Total value of VP chips gained during play (1-VP and 5-VP chips).

categories.label: Developments (printed VP)
categories.hint: Sum of the number in each development's hexagon.

categories.label: Colonies (printed VP, incl. home)
categories.labelVi: Thuộc địa (VP in sẵn, gồm quê nhà)
categories.hint: Sum of the number in each colony's hexagon, including the home colony. Explored worlds do not score.

categories.label: Bonus VP from '?' tiles
categories.hint: Variable bonuses on 9-cost developments and a few colonies, as written on each tile.

categories.label: Goal tiles (optional)
categories.hint: Only when playing with goals: VP from each goal tile in play.

categories.label: Credits + goods in empire (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Tín dụng + hàng hóa (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Not counting items on stockpile tiles.

tiebreakers.description: Most credits and goods in empire (excluding stockpile tiles)
If still tied, tied players jointly win.

endCondition.description: After a round in which any player has >10 mat spaces of developments, >7 colonies incl. home, fewer than 5 colonists after a Settle action, or the VP chip pool is emptied; finish that round.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Printed VP values and '?' bonuses are on tiles, so they are scorer inputs. Remove explored worlds before scoring. Goals are an optional rule.
